changelog:
Version 2.1.0 introduces expanded tool coverage and new admin capabilities.

- Added `users_me` (identity check) to read-only tools.
- Increased tool counts per privilege tier (now 7/13/18).
- Introduced new admin features: database update and dedicated page-move endpoint.
- Updated description and listed current API (v0.4) support.
